answer: Anchor each agent to a hardware root of trust: it must present a fresh remote-attestation quote from a secure enclave, and one physical chip can mint only one identity per epoch. Like a lotus blooming from a single rooted stem, each account maps to real silicon. An atlas of enclave fingerprints lets peers spot cloned quotes, and a falcon-eyed audit rejects any reused attestation, so a sybil army costs one chip per fake identity: linear hardware capital, never free copies.
